title: SkillChain findings ledger
description: A stage-local findings ledger under specs/PROJ-<X>-<theme>/<stage>/findings.json, written ONLY via chain findings. Readers aggregate known stage folders and an existing legacy root ledger. IDs are unique per PROJ; PR bodies and reports use the aggregate without creating another ledger.

source.description: Origin of the FIRST report; later duplicate reports append to sources[]

sources.description: All sources that reported this finding (dedup preserves attribution)

severity.description: Normalized severity (mapping table embedded in chain findings). Critical/High block; Medium/Low auto-defer as debt (§8).

anchor.description: Symbol/regex anchor (preferred over line numbers — parallel fixers shift lines)

debt_marker.description: debt: marker text when deferred as debt
